admission.justification: The cases catch a false landed claim inferred from recorded cells, a missing branch or a refused abandonment.

applicability: Successful abandon answers with an existing distinct recorded code work branch and source line.
conditions: Measure branch existence and source ancestry before the removal path runs.
Attach landedWork only when the operation result succeeds; refused results remain silent.
Use Git ancestry rather than possibly stale integration cells.
exclusions: A missing work branch, identical branch names or an unmerged tip yields no landed fact.
The observation does not bypass terminal admission, provider liveness, approval, dirty-work or unmerged-work checks.
